### Burgundy (Bourgogne) and Franche-Comté

To the east lies Bourgogne, with Dijon, Auxerre, Chalon-sur-Saône, Mcon, and Nevers. The vineyards and Romanesque towns are evident by the map’s town density in valleys.

Adjacent is Franche-Comté, with Besançon, Belfort, Lons-le-Saunier, and Vesoul, touching the Swiss border and nestled within the Jura Mountains.
